column3: Freeze the versioned protocol and source/license/snapshot manifest before collecting data; record exclusions and immutable IDs, and keep corpus acquisition inside the plan's explicit boundary.

After protocol-corpus-lock, build deterministic fixtures and validate repository/blob/time/prompt-family split disjointness, malformed/generated/duplicate cases, and exact/near-duplicate leakage controls; publish hashes and fixture report.

After fixtures-and-split-audit, run structural, lexical, repository-architecture, denominator, missingness, and uncertainty measures with raw rows and per-repository/per-stratum outputs; preserve unavailable measures as na.

After protocol, fixtures, and measurement prerequisites, run behavioral/generative controls and mutations; record exact LoRA/QLoRA dependency/resource preflight and keep the arm BLOCKED unless real pinned weight updates and artifacts are produced.

After measured artifacts exist, package costs/report/claim matrix and independently rerun hashes, split checks, at least two controls, one mutation, and headline metrics; record PASS or concrete failure and retain all blocked states.
